name: com.cssalt.llm-interface
description: Voice/LLM control layer for Unity scenes. ContextCommander turns named directions + amounts into precise Transform moves and rotations — the code owns every sign, so left/right can never silently flip. The LLM Interface adds push-to-talk speech → Whisper → chat model → bracket commands, dispatched to ContextCommander, with bundled TTS (Deepgram + Browser) and a WebGL microphone. Two assemblies: use the scene-command core on its own, or the full voice stack.
